Need 24/7 Emergency AHU Repair?

Get a Certified Technician On-Site in Under 2 Hours

Is your Air Handling Unit broken down, leaving you in the sweltering heat or compromising critical operations? Don’t panic. Atlas Aircon is your reliable, round-the-clock solution for fast and professional emergency AHU repair, service, and installation. We handle all major brands and get your system back online, fast.

Call for Immediate Help Chat on WhatsApp

Why Choose Atlas Aircon?

Your Trusted Partner for Critical AHU Solutions

Certified Technicians

Our team is highly trained and experienced in all aspects of AHU repair and maintenance.

24/7 Emergency Service

We’re available any time, any day. Your emergency is our priority. We are the best AHU service center near me.

Transparent Pricing

No hidden fees. We provide clear, upfront service charges and visit charges before any work begins.

100% Satisfaction

We guarantee quality workmanship and parts, ensuring your complete satisfaction with every job.

Complete AHU Solutions

We service, repair, and replace every component of your Air Handling Unit.

Filter Assembly

  • Primary Filters & Pre-Filters
  • Panel Filters & Pleated Filters
  • Washable Filters & Metal Mesh Filters
  • Secondary Filters (Fine, Bag, Pocket, Rigid Cell)
  • HEPA Filters & ULPA Filters
  • Gas Phase & Odor Control Filters
  • Activated Carbon Filters / Charcoal Filters
  • All related parts: Filter Media, Rolls, Pads, Frames, Clips & Gaskets.

Fan Assembly

  • Centrifugal Fans (Forward-Curved, Backward-Inclined, Airfoil)
  • Plenum Fans & Plug Fans
  • Repair/Replacement of: Impeller, Fan Wheel, Fan Shaft, Bearings (Pillow Block, Flange, Ball, Roller)
  • Pulleys, Sheaves, V-Belts, Taper-Lock Bushings
  • Electric Motor (AC/DC, VFD compatible motor)
  • Motor Starter, Contactors, Overload Relays
  • Vibration Isolation (Spring Isolators, Rubber Mounts)

Thermal Components

  • Cooling Coil Repair & Replacement
  • Chilled Water Coils & Direct Expansion (DX) Coils
  • Evaporator coil repair & services
  • Heating Coils (Hot Water, Steam, Electric Resistance)
  • Drainage repair, Condensate Drain Pan & Float Switch
  • Protective Coil Coatings (Anti-Corrosion)
  • Expert copper piping and gas refilling services.

Airflow Control

  • Dampers and Actuators repair
  • Volume Control Dampers (VCD)
  • Fire Dampers & Smoke Dampers
  • Face and Bypass Dampers, Mixing Box Dampers
  • Electric Actuators (Modulating, On/Off)
  • Pneumatic Actuators

Sensors, Controls & Casing

  • Complete AHU circuit repair
  • Temperature, Humidity & Pressure Sensors
  • Air Quality Sensors (CO2, VOC)
  • DDC Controller troubleshooting & programming
  • Thermostats, Control Valves, Airflow Switches
  • Access Doors, Panels, Hinges, Latches
  • Insulated Panels, Gaskets, Sealants, Viewports

Other Specialized Services

  • Complete Air Handling Unit Services
  • Commercial AC Repair
  • Industrial Chiller Plant Service
  • Ductable AC Repair & Installation
  • VRF/VRV System Maintenance
  • Jet pump service
  • View All Repair Services

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Your questions, answered.

How quickly can you arrive for an emergency AHU repair?

We guarantee a certified technician will be on-site in under 2 hours from your call, anywhere in our service areas across Gujarat.

What are your service charges for an emergency visit?

Our standard visit charges start from ₹500. This includes initial diagnosis. We provide a full, transparent quote for any repairs or parts before proceeding with the work.

Do you service all brands of AHUs?

Yes, our technicians are certified and experienced in AHU repair, service, and installation for all major national and international brands.

Is your AHU repair service available 24/7?

Absolutely. We are a 24/7 emergency service provider. You can call us anytime, including weekends and holidays, for immediate assistance.

What kind of AHU filter services do you provide?

We handle a complete range of filter services, including supply and replacement of Primary Filters, Pre-Filters, Panel Filters, Pleated Filters, Washable Filters, Metal Mesh Filters, Secondary Filters, Fine Filters, Bag Filters, HEPA Filters, ULPA Filters, and Gas Phase Filters like Activated Carbon Filters.

Can you repair issues with the AHU fan assembly?

Yes, we repair and replace all components of the fan assembly, including Centrifugal Fans, Plenum Fans, Impellers, Fan Shafts, Bearings, Pulleys, V-Belts, and Electric Motors (including VFD compatible motors).

My AHU is not cooling. Can you fix it?

Certainly. We specialize in cooling coil repair and evaporator coil repair. We can fix leaks, clean coils, or replace Chilled Water Coils and Direct Expansion (DX) Coils.

What does your AHU installation service include?

Our complete AHU installation service includes site assessment, unit selection, professional installation, ductwork connection, and final commissioning to ensure optimal performance.

Do you provide service in GIDC areas?

Yes, we provide priority AHU repair service to all major cities and specially GIDC of Gujarat state, including Vapi, Ankleshwar, Dahej, and others. We understand the critical nature of industrial HVAC systems.

What are the signs I need emergency AHU repair?

Common signs include no airflow, strange noises (grinding, squealing), water leakage from the unit, a sudden spike in energy bills, or the system blowing warm air. If you notice any of these, call us immediately.

Do you offer a warranty on your repairs?

Yes, we offer a service warranty on our repair work and a manufacturer’s warranty on all new parts installed. We stand by our commitment to 100% customer satisfaction.

Can you handle AHU gas refilling?

Yes, we provide professional gas refilling services for DX type AHU coils, ensuring the correct refrigerant levels for efficient operation.

My AHU has drainage problems. Can you fix the drainage repair?

Yes, we perform complete drainage repair, including cleaning clogged drain lines, repairing or replacing the Condensate Drain Pan, and fixing issues with the Drain Pan Float Switch.

What about electrical issues like circuit repair?

Our certified technicians are experts in electrical diagnostics and circuit repair for AHUs, including troubleshooting Motor Starters, Contactors, Overload Relays, and the main DDC Controller.

Are your prices transparent?

Transparency is key to our service. We provide a detailed, itemized price list and quote before any work begins. There are no hidden charges. Our service charges are competitive and affordable.

Don’t Wait for a Complete Breakdown!

Restore your comfort and operational efficiency now. Call the experts at Atlas Aircon for immediate, reliable emergency AHU service.
